task: Independent review of vector_addition frozen integer/bool five-module package plus root public specification wrapper
review_method: Read all five producer Lean modules, thin public wrapper, original Python kernel/wrapper/harness, original DSL kernel and shared FixedInteger evaluator laws.
Recomputed 214 frozen artifact hashes and 158 dependency hashes against current source roots; before and after dependency manifests are identical.

Checked all six actual exit-0 compile receipts/logs and source fingerprints, 20 total named axiom checks, three specification noncircularity checks, zero warnings. Existing passed modules were not recompiled.
Recomputed original and extracted-kernel AST equality, all 189 successful TTIR hashes, and all 289 promotion/frontend/scope rows.

Independently parsed all 81 integer/bool final-store SSA dataflow graphs, tracing pointer roots, shared offset/mask, bool i8 load/nonzero normalization, signed/unsigned operand extensions, promoted-width addition and output truncation/extension. Every traced graph matches the reviewed fixed-width formula; same-width bitcasts were treated as bit identity.

semantic_assessment.source_execution: All eight original computational statements are represented; execution success is proved, not assumed. Both input loads happen before all stores. The typed source is manually materialized, with source/native refinement still open.
semantic_assessment.finite_width_values: castValue uses BitVec.ofInt plus signed toInt or unsigned toNat; source operators reuse shared evaluated fixed-width casts. The sum is cast at the promotion width before destination storage conversion.
semantic_assessment.canonical_domain: Nine canonical integer/bool input kinds produce 81 ordered pairs. canonical_promotion and canonical_store are kernel-checked finite case proofs against the frozen DTypeScope rules.
semantic_assessment.boolean_semantics: Raw logical int storage is normalized with !=0 on load; bool/bool addition wraps at unsigned i1 before zero extension to signed i8 storage. bool+int8 stores the byte, e.g. 1+2 stores 3, without nonzero output normalization.
semantic_assessment.memory_and_grid: The independent single-program formula uses initial cell values and masked scatter. The ascending grid runs each program on previous memory. Proved next-tile independence permits equal logical input/output region names and yields a whole initial-memory result plus frame for all other addresses.
semantic_assessment.mask_domain: Inactive loads retain unspecified storage-channel values. No finite-value hypothesis is introduced, and masked stores keep inactive results outside the final memory formula.
semantic_assessment.public_wrapper: The specification command delegates directly to IntegerValueCorrect.correct with identical premises and concrete result. It adds public registration and an axiom audit without strengthening the theorem.
semantic_assessment.numerical_contract: The integer theorem has no floating binary/cast callback in its source or result; arbitrary M is unused by the integer graph. No new deferred numerical assumption is needed for this logical BitVec theorem.

scope_assessment.boundary: The finite 17-signature audit does not enumerate the whole original Torch dtype, device, layout, error or runtime domain. Observed frontend errors are not formal native error theorems.

integration_metadata.source_view_constraint: Keep the unchanged original add_kernel as the shared DSL source view; do not label the manually materialized integer source as a proved shared-DSL/native refinement.
integration_metadata.coverage_constraint: Describe complete ordered logical grid for 81 canonical integer/bool pairs; do not infer arbitrary native scheduling, native dispatch or full original-program completion.

structural_blockers_preserved: Native source/compiler refinement and complete error/admission behavior, including the remaining promoted and unsupported dtype domains.

Logical Int/Nat tag decoding must be related to valid native source-width bytes. Signed/unsigned loads are not independently narrowed at source width; representability is required in the missing bridge. Wrong-tag Cell.read defaults are not native byte reinterpretation.

Native pointer/address/launch arithmetic uses finite widths, whereas logical offsets/grid sizes use Nat. Pinned debug=false,sanitize_overflow=true IR observations do not prove native sanitizer behavior.
Physical allocation, base pointers, offsets, strides and overlap across differently sized dtypes are not captured by equal logical region names.
Only ascending logical program order is proved in this integer package. Native instruction interleavings, race/error behavior and runtime scheduling remain open.
Host empty_like allocation, native dtype dispatch, existing CUDA assertion, absent shape/length/layout guards, harness execution and module initialization are not composed with the new integer proof.
evidence_limitations: The producer 158-file snapshot omits lakefile.toml. This review binds its current hash; root integration full build remains the environment verification.
External libraries and native backend were not rebuilt by this independent review; no GPU execution was performed.
SSA graph audit is independently checked frontend evidence, not a formal proof of native compiler or GPU semantics.
required_root_integration_checks: Preserve frozen source hashes when copying six modules.
Run repository build and catalog/acceptance validation after the combined batch is registered.
Keep whole-original-program completion increment at zero.
